As part of the Hong Kong Baptist University Global Study Tour hosted by the ANU McCusker Institute, I ran a session entitled <i>Emergence and Hopeful Futures: Beauty of Self-organisation</i> to inspire students with the priniciples of self-organisation that is pivotal in endowing many systems in nature and society with adaptability and resilience under constant changes. This was a compact version, condensed to fit in an hour-long session from the original duration of 2.5hr-long, as a recurring workshop in each semester as part of the McCusker Institute's SoCIETIE program.
